verdict.rationale: ELSTER documents a sanctioned delegation route: powers of attorney (Vollmachten) can be filed electronically with the tax office. Organisations can also name mailbox representatives (Postfachvertreter), and any ELSTER-supporting tax software can transmit through the same channel. Each is only a one-line mention, and the Postfachvertreter role is internal and limited to viewing messages. missing for 10: documentation of how an authorized representative or tax advisor actually files on the company's behalf, the scope and revocation of Vollmachten, a provider-facing authorization or registration process, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: Sie können Vollmachten elektronisch bei Ihrem Finanzamt einreichen.
Innerhalb einer Organisation können Postfachvertreter benannt werden, um Nachrichten im Posteingang einzusehen.
Sie können aber auch jede andere Steuersoftware verwenden, die ELSTER unterstützt.
